setup.recorded: A fixed torso form wears a prepared wireless bra fitted with a BraBuilders Mini 2 Hook closure (32 mm high, three eye rows, nominally 55–56 mm closed width), two ordinary underside hooks engaging recessed eyes with overlapping tapes. The non-working garment is supported on the form; two 83 mm elastic working wings end in loose tapes, initially 80 mm apart. Hook spacing is 16 mm and wire diameter 0.8 mm. Both arms use 40 x 6 x 1 mm finger extensions with a 4 N jaw limit. Fixed dimensions and layout are in the README and geometry.py.
setup.submission: A rigid dressmaker’s bust manikin with an oval band-line cross-section (260 mm side to side × 160 mm front to back, measured 155 mm above the tabletop) wears a prepared Simplicity 8711 size-32A bra fitted with a BraBuilders Mini 2 Hook closure (32 mm high, three eye rows, nominally 55–56 mm closed width), two ordinary underside hooks engaging recessed eyes with overlapping tapes. The non-working garment is supported on the form; the two working wings each have an unloaded span of 83 ± 2 mm from the fixed wing anchor to the tape seam, with the loose tape centres 80 ± 2 mm apart. Hook spacing is 16 mm and wire diameter 0.8 mm. Both arms use 40 x 6 x 1 mm finger extensions with a 4 N jaw limit. Fixed dimensions and layout are in the README and geometry.py.
